nameEn: Manufacture of office machinery and equipment (except computers and peripheral equipment)
description: This class includes the manufacture of office machinery and equipment, excluding computers and computer peripheral equipment.
includes: manufacture of mailing machines, mail handling machinery: letter openers, folding machines, inserting machines, addressing machines
manufacture of calculators, electronic or not
manufacture of stapling machines, punching machines
excludes: manufacture of computers and peripheral equipment, see 2620
